
```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Peak ground acceleration design values [%s] for reference site conditions Vs30 = %d m/s. Columns report percentile intervals and mean values are highlighted in bold."
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "PGA.qmd",
  suffix = ".max",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("TR.target")) TR.target <- TR.gmdp
if (!exists("PSA_Units")) PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
root <- here::here()
```
